# Resilience & UX Telemetry Checklist: Live Strategy Backtest Progress & Crash Resilience

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality across live backtest progress telemetry, black-screen crash prevention, and multi-asset batch performance
**Created**: 2026-10-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all required fields of the live backtest progress status contract (`status`, `strategy_id`, `strategy_name`, `timeframe`, `total_symbols`, `completed_symbols`, `current_symbol`, `progress_pct`, `elapsed_ms`, `message`) explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are the visual elements of the live execution progress card (ticker counter, current symbol, strategy/timeframe badges, progress bar, and elapsed timer) fully enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK003 Are the recovery elements of the workspace error boundary (`ErrorBoundary` fallback card, diagnostic message, and one-click reset action) explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK004 Is the human-readable progress message format (`Evaluating K / N tickers — <SYMBOL>...`) unambiguously specified for single-asset and multi-asset runs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK005 Are the exact fallback strings (`$0.00`, `0.00%`, `Open`, `—`) specified for null, undefined, or non-finite numeric and date fields? [Clarity, Spec §US2, §FR-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK006 Do the backend progress telemetry fields in `data-model.md` and `contracts/backtest-progress-api.md` align 100% with the TypeScript interface `YahooBacktestStatusResponse`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK007 Does the vectorized indicator precomputation requirement for `DarwinTrendStrategy` preserve 100% signal and PnL parity with the existing strategy rules? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007]

## Edge Case & Exception Coverage

- [x] CHK008 Is the UI behavior specified when a selected ticker has zero stored price bars (`NO_DATA` / empty chart overlay)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK009 Is default ticker initialization specified to prioritize tickers with stored historical bars (`price_bars_count > 0`) over zero-bar metadata stubs? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK010 Is the handling of benign WebSocket proxy disconnect errors (`ECONNABORTED`, `ECONNRESET`, `EPIPE`) specified for the development server? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008]

## Measurability & Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK011 Are latency and refresh targets quantified (`100ms` UI elapsed timer refresh, `>= 3x` batch speedup on 20 tickers)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK012 Is thread safety specified for concurrent reads and writes to `_backtest_state` under `_yahoo_lock`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Assumptions]
